description: Requests the WAF blocked, challenged or logged for a pull zone. Only the last 72 hours are available. Use group_by to summarise, e.g. ["ruleId"], ["ja4"] or ["ip"]. Events can take a minute to appear, so wait at least a minute after a change before judging it.

detail.description: Include each group's full context object (large). Default false

from.description: ISO 8601 date-time, within the last 72 hours

query.description: Free text across IP, ruleId, URL, User-Agent and rule name

name: shield_event_logs
